lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines visible. Spacing is tightest at the posterior flank (avg 20 pixels) and widest at the mid-section (avg 45 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped convergence is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 4th and 5th lines from the anterior, where they merge into a single point at the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most (12th) line is reduced to a single dash segment; the anterior-most (1st) line is abbreviated and does not extend to the ventral line; the 9th line from the anterior terminates midway down the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch. One primary circular spot (approx. 10px diameter) and one smaller elliptical satellite spot (approx. 5px) located 15 pixels anterior-ventral to the primary.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate spiral; projecting outward at approx 45 degrees from the frontal bone before curving posteriorly and then medially at the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.7 times the width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the terminal 12% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white spot on the lower mandible/cheek; white horizontal banding present on the carpus of the forelimb and the tarsus of the hindlimb.
